controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:25:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:25:00.000Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
        sample_msg = MIN(message)
    BY minute = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)
| SORT minute
